steps.input:
mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-3b27a375.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Identify the color used for the full-width/full-height separators.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    sep = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == sep for row in grid)]
    rb = [-1] + row_bars + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + col_bars + [len(grid[0])]
    rr = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    cc = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(cb, cb[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    counts = {}
    for r0, r1 in rr:
        for c0, c1 in cc:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    v = grid[r][c]
                    if v != sep:
                        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] not in (bg, sep) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) > 1 else bg for c0, c1 in cc] for r0, r1 in rr]
PY
